notes: Preparation footage only. Actual public unpaid practice and disabled protected flows. Never label this a funded payout demo.

shots.title: English public home
shots.narration: DROP is a community reward game built for Monad. This preparation recording shows the current website. The games here are unpaid practice, not a completed payout.

shots.title: Actual catch practice
shots.narration: The catch game works with a keyboard or touch. Three catches finish this practice. Practice creates no reward, qualification, or payment record.

shots.title: Actual quiz practice
shots.narration: The other game is a three question quiz. This example explains server verification and the difference between test tokens and rewards with real value.

shots.title: Honest current integration limits
shots.narration: Real reward participation still needs configured authentication, application database access, funded escrow, and a running payout processor. This screen does not invent a balance or a successful payment.
